facts.fact: Burundi carried out its combined population, housing, agriculture and livestock census (RGPHAE) in 2024, run entirely in digital mode.

note: Definitive results only before the Council of Ministers as a draft decree on 2026-08-28; not stated as published, so no results fact.

facts.fact: INSBU's results pages state the RGPHAE 2024 census was carried out in 2024, counting 12,332,788 residents by exhaustive enumeration; the results shown are preliminary, published under decree 100/032 of 27 March 2025.

Decree 100/032 of 27 March 2025 publishes preliminary results of the RGPHAE 2024 census, counting 12,332,788 residents and 2,724,457 ordinary households, pending definitive results; the decree gives no enumeration date, so the census edition year is used.

facts.fact: The UN Demographic Yearbook metadata, completed by the Bureau Central du Recensement, states a full census (RGPHAE 2024) was carried out in 2024 with all administrative entities enumerated, and that preliminary census results were produced in December 2024; final results are still to come.
